messages:
maya patel: Heads up — healthscore sampler is re-firing onboarding playbooks for recent imports. 2.3% spike in nudge volume since midnight :grimace:
jordan wu: Ugh. Any obvious signal? new import flag or timestamp drift? :eyes:
maya patel: Looks tied to the 'last_touch' null -> default behavior in the sampler. Newly imported accounts get scored as low and trigger onboarding nudges immediately. logs show repeated sampler runs for same accounts. snippet below from sampler log:
```
INFO sampler run=2024-11-14T02:01:23Z accounts_processed=3245 rerun_for_missing_last_touch=498
```
samir rao: quick mitigation: add a grace_window param (7 days) to playbook trigger and pause re-evaluations for freshly-imported rows. low-risk and quick to patch. cc @leah o'neill for PR
leah o'neill: I can take the PR. Proposed toggles: admin UI toggle + flag on playbook config. Want admin toggle so CS can flip without a deploy.
jordan wu: Also add a backfill job to mark import_date for older rows that are missing it. Otherwise the grace window won't help historical noise.
playbook-bot: Alert: onboarding-nudge-volume increased by 2.3% (threshold 1.5%). Triggered at 2024-11-14T02:05:12Z. Linked incidents/8472
maya patel: example SQL for backfill i ran locally (dry-run):
```
-- mark import_date for legacy rows based on first_event
UPDATE accounts a
SET import_date = sub.first_seen
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_seen
  FROM events
  WHERE created_at < now() - interval '30 days'
  GROUP BY account_id
) sub
WHERE a.account_id = sub.account_id AND a.import_date IS NULL;
```
samir rao: Thanks. Plan: (1) short-term: deploy grace_window=7d to playbook config and flip admin toggle off for newly-imported cohort; (2) run backfill dry-run then schedule backfill; (3) add unit test for sampler to ignore import_date < now()-grace_window; (4) post-rollout monitor 48h.
cs-ops: I can run the backfill dry-run in staging and report results by EOD. Please drop the SQL into #cs-ops-runbook when ready.
leah o'neill: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cs-playbooks/pull/482 — adds grace_window, admin toggle, and a migration for import_date. Added docs in the playbook admin README.
jordan wu: Nice. Can we also add a metric tag 'imported:true/false' to the nudge metric so we can filter spikes later? small change to the metric emitter.
maya patel: Yes pls. Add to PR or a follow-up. After staging dry-run we'll flip toggle and monitor. :thumbsup:
playbook-bot: Note: playbook config version bumped to v1.12.3 in staging. Rollout plan requires manual toggle confirmation.
maya patel: Thanks all — appreciate the quick pivot. I'll coordinate monitoring and post results here.
